description:
Retrieves the space role mode.

Available on tenants with [Role-Based Access Control](https://support.atlassian.com/confluence-cloud/docs/manage-user-roles/). 

**[Permissions](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/_AozKw) required**:
Permission to access the Confluence site ('Can use' global permission).

200.description: Returned if the requested space role mode is returned.

400.description: Returned if an invalid request is provided.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing from the request.

404.description: Returned if the calling user does not have permission to view the space role mode.
